name: ThinkPol
description: Optional Reddit archive search through the ThinkPol API: exhaustive keyword and phrase search over Reddit submissions and comments, including content later removed or deleted, plus user histories, threads and subreddit context. Activated only when THINKPOL_API_KEY is set; the Engine injects it when ThinkPol is enabled in Indicator Labs, from-repo users export it themselves.
use_when: A lead or claim may have been discussed on Reddit: find who said what and when by exact phrase, recover a removed or deleted post or comment, read one account's history, or pull a whole thread. Archived text is a lead to corroborate, not proof.
rate_limit_note: Every request draws on the key's query quota (`quota` reports what is left); one search returns at most 50 records, so page deliberately. Proprietary ThinkPol terms: no redistribution or resale of the data without authorization.
